email_subject: Application - Customer Support Specialist at Spott
email_body:
Dear Spott team,

I'm applying for the Customer Support Specialist role. Your mission to reset recruitment with an AI-native platform resonates with me, and I'd love to be the person recruiters rely on when something is unclear or broken.

In my current roles, I handle client inquiries and troubleshoot website issues daily. I dig into problems myself—whether it's a broken layout, a tracking error, or a content update—and see them through to resolution. I'm fluent in English and comfortable writing clear, friendly replies that get to the point. I also use AI tools and code to automate repetitive work, which aligns with shaping support processes as Spott grows.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, close to Leuven, and excited about the opportunity to work in-person at your HQ. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my troubleshooting mindset and ownership can contribute to your support team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Spott team,

I'm writing to apply for the Customer Support Specialist role. As someone who has spent years solving problems on the web—from debugging front-end code to optimizing sites for search—I'm drawn to Spott's mission of resetting recruitment with an AI-native platform. The idea of being the first dedicated support specialist, owning the inbox end to end, and shaping how support works as you scale is exactly the kind of ownership I thrive on.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I'm often the first point of contact for client issues. Whether it's a broken WordPress layout, a tracking discrepancy, or a content update, I dig into the product myself, find the root cause, and see it through to resolution. I've built and maintained websites for clients across various sectors, which has taught me to troubleshoot under pressure and communicate clearly—often explaining technical details in plain language. I use AI tools daily to automate repetitive tasks, which I believe will be valuable as Spott looks to streamline support processes.

My background includes front-end development, so I'm comfortable reading code and understanding technical issues. I'm fluent in English and have a troubleshooting mindset: I don't just forward tickets; I investigate and suggest solutions. While I haven't used Pylon, Linear, Intercom or Zendesk, I've quickly adapted to new tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, and various CMS platforms. I'm eager to learn your stack and contribute from day one.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, a short commute to Leuven, and excited about the prospect of working in-person with your team. I'd love the chance to discuss how my problem-solving skills and ownership mindset can help Spott's customers succeed.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
